d: Platinum white wavy hair reaches the shoulders with long bangs swept to the side, framing a face of a mature adolescent with a slender build. The golden-yellow eyes are narrow and drooping with a sleepy expression. A black high-collared garment is worn under a dark outfit, accented by a crown of dark thorns and golden floral ornaments resting atop the head. Pointed elf-like ears protrude from the sides of the head.
